categories.main_business_segments: Tiangong International Company Limited operates primarily in five segments: Die Steel (DS), High Speed Steel (HSS), Cutting Tools, Titanium Alloy, and Others (mainly power tool kits assembly and sales). DS and HSS are high alloy special steels used in die casting, tooling, and manufacturing industries. Cutting tools include HSS and carbide tools for industrial and civil applications. Titanium alloy products serve aerospace, medical, consumer electronics, and other high-end sectors. The Others segment focuses on assembling and exporting power tool kits.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced powder metallurgy and additive manufacturing technologies, especially for die-casting die steel and high-speed steels. It uses vacuum electron beam (EB) furnace technology for titanium alloy production, enhancing recycled material utilization and product quality. The company integrates intelligent manufacturing systems including ERP, MES, SCADA, and automated logistics to optimize production efficiency and quality. It also develops specialized products like double spiral hole carbide rods to improve tool performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in automotive (notably new energy vehicles), aerospace, machinery manufacturing, consumer electronics, medical devices, and home appliances sectors. The Group serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, including North America and Europe. Its products are used in die casting molds, cutting tools, precision manufacturing, and additive manufacturing applications. The Group also supplies downstream customers with integrated die-casting components and value-added services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates mainly in China with production bases in Jiangsu Province and Thailand. It has an expanding global footprint with export markets in North America, Europe, and other regions. The Thailand production base supports export growth, especially in cutting tools. The Group’s international expansion includes certification achievements and strategic partnerships to penetrate global high-end materials markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tiangong International operates across upstream and midstream segments of the supply chain. It produces raw and specialty materials such as DS, HSS, and titanium alloys (upstream), manufactures cutting tools (midstream), and assembles power tool kits (downstream). The Group is also expanding into downstream value-added services like mold design and maintenance, aiming to provide comprehensive solutions across the die-casting mold materials and tooling supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes technology-driven innovation with an R&D expenditure exceeding 6% of revenue. It focuses on powder metallurgy, additive manufacturing, and intelligent manufacturing technologies. Key R&D initiatives include national projects on die-casting mold steel, development of high-performance cutting tools, and titanium alloy product enhancements for aerospace and medical applications. The Group is building a Precision Tools Research Institute and collaborates with universities and industry leaders to deepen its technological moat and support import substitution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of specialty steels (DS, HSS), cutting tools, titanium alloys, and assembled power tool kits. Sales are recognized at a point in time from contracts with customers. The Group also benefits from export sales and domestic sales, with a diversified customer base. It pursues value-added services and integrated solutions to enhance revenue streams, including mold materials and maintenance services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group faces competition from European and other international manufacturers, especially in export markets where price competition is intense. It holds a leading position in China’s high-end materials market, being the first Chinese company certified by NADCA and a pioneer in powder metallurgy and additive manufacturing technologies domestically. The Group leverages technological innovation, cost advantages, and integrated supply chain capabilities to maintain competitiveness and expand market share globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB4.83 billion, a 6.4% decrease from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB359 million. The Group has a substantial asset base exceeding RMB13 billion and equity of over RMB7.4 billion. Despite short-term revenue declines due to market conditions and pricing pressures, the Group demonstrates steady profitability and ongoing investment in capacity expansion and R&D. It maintains a moderate net debt-to-equity ratio around 36%, reflecting financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tiangong International emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced specialty steels and titanium alloys with superior thermal fatigue, wear resistance, and durability. Its vertically integrated production from raw materials to finished cutting tools provides cost advantages. The Group’s pioneering powder metallurgy and additive manufacturing capabilities enable import substitution and meet stringent international standards. Its commitment to green manufacturing, intelligent production, and comprehensive solutions for die-casting molds and tooling differentiates it as a leading advanced materials technology enterprise.
